summary:
# NOTES: "When Freemen Shall Stand" (Nelson S. Bond, 1943 pulp, Fantastic Adventures)

Frame: Venus (Daan) conquered Earth. Mt. Rushmore faces = gods giving hope.

## Ch I
- Lab, WWII. **Lt. Stephen "Steve" Duane**, chemist, acid apron. Assistant **Sgt. Chuck Lafferty** (calls Steve "Lootenant"; Steve wants plain "Steve"). Making anesthetic gas **methioprane**; plan to end war, "Hitler's panzers down."
- Door left open. Fake gas-mask guard = Nazi spy **Eric von Rath** (.44, "Leutnant," accent). Steve's "Achtung" trick fails to kill; von Rath forces Chuck to bring flask. Steve: "Give it to him." Chuck drops flask; mist; both paralyzed.
- Wake frozen, cold as marble, in windowless musty dome-chamber lit by candles. Von Rath too. Clothing: gold metal loincloth harness, metal-cloth cape, doeskin sandals ("18 karat panties"). Glass dome cracked near ceiling. Steve deduces catalepsy; years or centuries passed.

## Ch II
- Women enter: **Priestess Beth** (dust-gold hair, golden breast-cups, sarong, steel-blue eyes). Her retinue: obese pale matrons (breeders); lean granite warrior women led by captain **Jain** (leather breechclouts, halters, blades); thick peasant workers (felt aprons). Pet male: tiny, painted, samite frock, rouged, to be sacrificed to the "gods."
- Women chant US anthem, garbled ("Osé, can you see by the Daans' surly light," "rockets' red glare-bombs," "Thy hoam, O Thou Brave").
- Steve stops knife with raised arm. Women kneel. Mother-figure cries "The Slumberers have awakened!" Jain cranks rusted wheel; glass dome hoists.
- Beth's clan = **Tucki**. Steve: "Fautnox" = **Fort Knox**. Footnote: Fort Knox holds 75% of world gold (1942).
- Procession through crowds to "Mother of the Tucki Clan."

## Ch III
- **Mother Maatha** (white-haired, kind). Story: **Daan** = Venus; invaders from Daan (rockets) conquered Earth ~100 "seasons" ago, enslaved men and women; prophecy: Dwain (Duane) reveals Great Secret.
- Chuck: methioprane. Mother: sleep began **1942**; now **3488** ("Thirty-Fifth Century"). ~1500 years.
- Food brought by workers (golden trays). Steve: "We are but men." Beth shocked.
- Mother asks which Slumberer is "evil." Steve: none; "three brothers." Von Rath pledges alliance. Chuck suspicious.
- Mother forbids Beth hearing secrets until Pilgrimage to **'Kota** (Place of Gods). Steve: Dakota → Black Hills; Chuck: "Teddy" = Teddy/George/Thomas/Abraham.
- Warrior messenger: **Wild Ones** (male outlanders) attack.

## Ch IV
- Wild Ones: hairy males, jungles of Tizathy; raid to capture women ("linber" = kidnap, footnote 3); women kill wounded Wild Ones but capture wounded Women gently.
- Steve: Trojan horse trick (footnote 2). Trap Wild Ones in courtyard. Beth offers her golden knife to Steve, refuses treason; Steve: "Oh, nuts."
- Steve: "Woman, you question me? I am the Law!" Wild Ones' leader **Jon** ("I am a Man!").
- Steve takes Jon to Mother. Mother reveals **Revelation**: gods Jarg, Taamuz, Ibrim, Tedhi = Men; Men once ruled; women hid in forts; men starved; women-men war.
- Revelation quotes holy record: "fire-eggs," "snarling hand-bows," gas, "waters that burn."

## Ch V
- Steve's new order: Wild Ones and Women join; no castes; each woman chooses a mate. Beth chooses **Steve** as mate. Steve unsure; Chuck teases.
- Plan: summon clans. **Mother Mairlee of Lextun** (Maatha's sister), Tensee, Clina, Yana Clans. Jon summons Wild Ones.
- Mother: Daan fortress at **Sinnaty** (Cincinnati), = "Nedlunplaza" (Netherland Plaza). Von Rath: "Reds" = Bolsheviks; Chuck: Cincinnati Reds, dictator McKechnie.
- Party of 8: Steve, Chuck, von Rath, Jain + 3 women, Beth. Steve keeps von Rath under watch.
- Beth's usefulness: stars navigation, Rovers, hare-snaring. Steve sleeps apart from Beth (awkward).
- Covton (Covington). Glass/plastic bridge (von Rath: plastic, not glass). Six Daan captors: pale white, silver hair, fish-like webbing, carp jaw.
- Steve lies: "from Loovil." Daan captain orders capture.

## Ch VI
- Bound with plastic rope, marched into Sinnaty. Von Rath: "They're our enemies"; Chuck: Hitler pipeline joke.
- Sinnaty: squalid, humans in shacks. Carew Tower survives. Nedlunplaza = gilded Daan fortress.
- Elevator to high prison floor. Prisoners: humans, Wild Ones, Daan-type men. Shout "Women!" Tucki guards draw.
- **Rodrik of Mish-kin** (tall blond, Michigan). Claims ruler, claims Beth. Steve: "I am the Law."

## Ch VII
- Rodrik duel challenge (Law: trial by combat). Steve beats him (Queensbury rules, "Intercollegiate Fisticuffs Champion"). Rodrik kicks groin, then Steve KO's him ("on the house").
- Rodrik's men acclaim Steve ruler. Lieutenant **Jak of Norlinz** (New Orleans). Steve orders Rodrik saved ("I am the Law" 2nd time). Rodrik: "Forgive me, brother," hints at a Brotherhood.
- Beth kisses Steve (touching-of-mouths). Jak: Tizathy = all old US; Zoni, Mexco, Bama, Sippi.
- **Overlord Loala** (silver-haired, gray-green eyes, Daan female; "Princess of Beauty" flattery). Advisors: **Malgro** (hostile), **Okuno** (kind). Steve "Steve of Emmeity, M.I.T." Asked re Fautnox; Steve denies; asked re Slumberers.
- Loala offers Steve consort. Condition: join **Brotherhood** (human Fifth Column). Loala: "Treatment" in electric-chair-like cabinet; brain-pattern "nerve image" cylinder; "you die instantly" if betrayal.

## Ch IX (numbered 9)
- Steve learns Rodrik was Brother/spy. Loala sends Steve to Fautnox with guards; Steve insists on female escort.
- Treatment: Steve passes out; wakes with Daan knowledge (Kraama month, fortresses Kleevlun, Slooie, Yanaplis, Davun).

## Ch X
- Steve's "Brother" plan. Rodrik & Steve reach Fautnox. Steve reveals he knows Fautnox; Rodrik taken prisoner.
- Fautnox army: Mother counts **2,804** warriors (14 Women clans, 12 Wild Ones tribes).
- Steve sends Rodrik away with von Rath (guard). Steve's plan: march on **Loovil**. Loovil: 400 Daans. Battle; Daan ray-weapons. Surrender of remnant; Steve forbids slaughter.
- Chuck: von Rath freed Rodrik. Rodrik heads to Sinnaty.

## Ch XI
- Von Rath admits: "realist." Steve: "Von Rath is mine."
- Steve pursues Rodrik (Covton, bridge). Rodrik and Steve taken by Daan patrol to Overlord Okuno (Chief Executioner).
- Rodrik accuses Steve. Steve confesses he is a Slumberer. Okuno: execution of traitor by brain cylinder destruction; Rodrik killed. (Tension: Steve knows Okuno is hiding something.)

## Ch XII
- Okuno = earthman **Wiam of Kleevlun**, masquerading; swapped Rodrik's cylinder for Steve's. Changelings across Tizathy (bleached hair, webbing).
- Loovil retaken by Daans. Beth, Mother Maatha, Shuk of Bruklin exiled to Daan. Jain, Mairlee dead.
- Von Rath alive (wounded, amnesic), listed "Ay-rik."
- Steve to Daan as **Captain Huumo**. Plan: immobilize Daan armada. Okuno's password: "Have you kinsmen on distant Terra?" / "Aye, I have many brothers." / "The brave never lack for brethren." Steve's face altered: bleached hair, webbing.

## Ch XIII
- Spaceport on Observatory Hill, Sinnaty. Spaceship **Oalumuo**. Officer Thaamo. Loala boards too, recognizes Steve.
- 10-day space voyage. Observatory deck: stars. Steve memorizes controls, atomic motors, air systems, ray-gun locations.
- Planet Daan: fog, gray skies, Sol's planets.

## Ch XIV
- Daan spaceport: 100 ships, metropolis. Steve's disdain for Daan decadence.
- Loala's aereo (atomic beam flight). Steve/Loala flirtation; Loala reads his lies.
- Supreme Council (languid "Masters"). Loala rebukes them about Earth rebels. Council sends Loala and Huumo to slave camp in equatorial swamps.

## Ch XV
- Heat; swamp fog. Slave camp (Chief Warden **Grudo**; guard **Amarro**, ex-Earth-visitor, kinder).
- Earth prisoners in pens. Beth calls "Dwain!" from crowd; Chuck covers her mouth. Mob cries "Betrayer!"; Amarro stops them with ray.
- Steve and Chuck private talk. Chuck: swamp-musk = Daan *klaar* ("nuisance weed") = methioprane base. Plan: lab in barracks; equipment smuggled as "water distillation unit."
- Von Rath amnesia recovering (at Daan hospital, bandaged).

## Ch XVI
- Steve asks Grudo for distillation apparatus. Loala suspicious; von Rath (recovered) identifies Steve as Slumberer.
- Steve tries to shoot von Rath; Grudo grabs weapon. Steve bound. Steve: "The curtain has not yet fallen."
- Loala: "Dying of hurt pride"; Steve to pens. Amarro, alone with Steve: "Have you kinsmen on distant Terra?"

## Ch XVII
- Amarro is Okuno's ally. Plan: Steve knocks out Amarro with ray-gun; flees to motor-skiff; refuge on hidden island (boulder door). Refuge: lab, ultra-wave communicator, food, books.
- Amarro smuggles methioprane containers. Strategic points: Armada ships, public buildings.
- Steve orders Okuno: "Strike when you will" (25 million miles, ultra-wave).
- Trap: Loala & Grudo, with Daan armed men, use Beth's voice. Steve captured, struck on head.

## Ch XVIII
- Steve in palace tower; Masters (three Venusians). Steve threatens; reveals Daan fifth columns; a Master slips: rebels succeed.
- Loala visits cell. Offers "Mental Laboratory" operation to erase Steve's brain and reprogram as loyal Daan. Steve must willingly enter.

## Ch XIX
- Steve bargains: amnesty for rebel comrades (Chuck, Beth). Loala agrees (Council's written orders heard via audio).
- Loala: Kleevlun, Washtun, Ashful, Sangleez, Blin, Lunnon, Kiro under rebel control; Sinnaty held by Okuno.
- Von Rath bursts in, shouts betrayal, fires ray at Steve.

## Ch XX
- Von Rath's ray hits Loala (burns); Loala's dagger misses; Steve strangles von Rath.
- Loala dying (charred flesh). Steve: "Loala... my princess." Loala: "Though science altered your brain... no instrument could erase the scorings on your heart."
- Chuck: rebels captured entire Armada (slaves released methioprane into ship air). Loala's pride.
- Steve orders methioprane for Loala; she sleeps (cannot die). Steve kisses her brow.
- Daan nobles sleep too; Council accepts terms: Earth self-governs; slaves freed; half the fleet to Earth; Daan science aids Earth.
- Fleet heads home; Steve: "Home!" Beth: "Because you are a man." Final verse of anthem: "And thus be it ever, when freemen shall stand... / Then conquer we must... In God is Our Trust... Star-Spangled Banner... O'er the land of the free... And thy hoam, O Thou Brave!" End: "For a woman always has the last word."
